constraints.name: anchor
limitations: Anchor datum/units must be harmonized externally; no provider truth assumed.
Normalized inverse-variance weights preserve m² loss units.

constraints.name: shadow
limitations: Finite-domain blockers only; external occlusion unobserved.
Geometric mask is not RGB radiance; requires independent observed shadow mask and sun metadata.
Global vertical offset is unidentifiable from shadows.

objective.weight_note: Losses have different units; coefficients carry reciprocal units or deliberate normalization. No universal weights or confidence inferred.
